column3: End of the Break
Well, everything is 【just a life experience】.
【Just a life experience】...
For the time being, please forget everything I said! It has nothing to do with why we're here today!
Even though you say that...
Why do you have such a lonely expression on your face...
Well then, the break is now over!
Let's relax a little more, alright? Isn't this a celebration?
We came all the way to Akihabara, we'd be missing out if we just lazed around!
If we don't go shopping more...
It is just as Kiririn-shi said, there are ways to enjoy yourself in Akihabara!
For once, I am in agreement.
Ah... the three of you, how young...
Well, they do have a point there.
In that case, let's walk the entire district!
Well then, I will go and check on the newly released games lineup.
I'm going too!
...Hmph. I guess there's no helping it.
These girls... making up such reasons, but they just want to go together, don't they?
I waited outside of the store for the three of them to come out.
Of course, in their hands were large quantities of otaku goods.
Alright everyone, how was today's harvest?
Well, pretty good I'd say?
I still have some places I want to look around at.
It's still the celebration after all! Well then, we'll move to the next location.
--And like that, the three of them went on a shopping spree.
As I was overcome by the heat, I spent a lot of energy and effort to catch up with the three of them.
Say, this doesn't seem to be any different compared to the weekends, does it?
Hahaha, isn't it great that way?
After all, it's best if it's the same as usual.
It's not like I'm really bothered by it... How should I put it...
Well, as long as they're enjoying themselves.
